definitions.explanation: Being outdoors without a roof or covering. Often used as a modifier to describe outdoor baths, mining operations, or other activities done under the open sky.

examples.japanese: {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This inn has rooms with private outdoor baths.

examples.japanese: ⟦{星空|ほしぞら}→星空：05048_hoshizora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧な{気持|きも}ちだ。
examples.english: Soaking in an outdoor bath under a starry sky is an exceptional feeling.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ} (open-air bath), a major attraction at Japanese hot springs (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧) and inns (⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧).

Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{露店|ろてん}→露店：10106_roten⟧ (street stall/vendor), which uses a different kanji for the second character (⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ = shop vs ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ = sky/heaven).

COMPOUNDS:
- {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ} (open-air bath)
- {露天|ろてん}{掘|ぼ}り (open-pit mining)
- {露天|ろてん}⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ (open-air parking lot)
